title: Support agent tab screen
summary: The tab bar always shows a Support tab first among agent tabs; it starts /grillo-support in the project and posts the support agent's relay requests into the named tab (chat runtime only).

deferred.what: The prototype screen-support-agent-tab's third state (the 'Relayed to …' note with Back to Support in the target tab, and the 'from Support, for <member>' badge on the relayed bubble) is built nowhere and no open story names it, so it silently never ships; issue #94 (chat view) implements screen-chat-view, which has neither.
deferred.why: A note in the target tab needs a controls slot on agent tabs that does not open a fixed side column on every tab: a change to the agent-tab seam, outside a story that must touch no shared file.
